local me = Game.GetLocalPlayer() local unit = UnitManager.GetUnit(me, 9) if unit == nil then print("ERR:UNIT_NOT_FOUND"); print("---END---"); return end
if not UnitManager.CanStartOperation(unit, UnitOperationTypes.FOUND_CITY, nil, true) then
    print("ERR:CANNOT_FOUND|Unit cannot found cities (not a settler or no moves)"); print("---END---"); return
end
local x, y = unit:GetX(), unit:GetY()
local plot = Map.GetPlot(x, y)
if plot:IsWater() then print("ERR:CANNOT_FOUND|Cannot found city on water"); print("---END---"); return end
if plot:IsMountain() then print("ERR:CANNOT_FOUND|Cannot found city on mountain"); print("---END---"); return end
for i = 0, 62 do
    if Players[i] and Players[i]:IsAlive() then
        local cities = Players[i]:GetCities()
        if cities then
            for _, c in cities:Members() do
                local dist = Map.GetPlotDistance(x, y, c:GetX(), c:GetY())
                if dist <= 3 then
                    print("ERR:CANNOT_FOUND|Too close to " .. Locale.Lookup(c:GetName()) .. " (settler at " .. x .. "," .. y .. ", distance " .. dist .. ", need > 3)"); print("---END---"); return
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
local params = {}
params[UnitOperationTypes.PARAM_X] = x
params[UnitOperationTypes.PARAM_Y] = y
pcall(function() LuaEvents.DiplomacyActionView_ShowIngameUI() end)
UnitManager.RequestOperation(unit, UnitOperationTypes.FOUND_CITY, params)
print("OK:FOUNDED|" .. x .. "," .. y)
print("---END---")
